series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits a consistent downward trend with moderate seasonality. Despite high model consensus, unstable rankings and concept drift are detected. A weighted combination with dynamic error adaptation is recommended to address the drift and unstable rankings.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → ADE dynamic error weighting adapts to concept drift by emphasizing recent model performance
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND recommended_knobs.shrinkage=0.35 → shrinkage prevents overfitting with few validation windows (n_windows=2)
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → per-horizon selection exploits differing model strengths across forecast horizons

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.avoid=ridge_stacking → regularization with few windows (n_windows=2) risks overfitting
